text:
danielle_sec: Heads-up — planning to cut over the new conditional egress policy to privnet at 16:00 UTC. This will limit KMS decrypt/keystore access to the 10.0.0.0/16 privnet range only. Expect effects on onboarding GPU nodes if their ephemeral NAT path isn't pinned.

ben_infra: Ack. do we have a quick list of warm-pool IPs to pre-allow? last time nodes failed join due to KMS decrypt errors and it took ages to triage. :grimacing:

carla_sre: FYI the symptom is usually STS/KMS 403 followed by kubelet failing to pull certs. Seen logs like:
```
2026-02-03T15:02:23Z kubelet[1234]: keystore: decrypt failed, status=403, key_id=alias/redwood/ephemeral
2026-02-03T15:02:23Z kubelet[1234]: node join failed: cannot fetch bootstrap certs
```

carla_sre: If the egress path changes mid-rotation the agent sometimes reuses old conntrack entry and gets SNATed to wrong IP.

alex_ml: Short mitigation options: 1) pre-allow warm-pool & canary subnets in KMS policy, 2) short maintenance window and staggered join, 3) fallback to previous keystore proxy for 30m. I'd vote for 1+2.

danielle_sec: Agree. Ops plan: canary in eu-west1 with 3 nodes from warm-pool, then expand. We'll add a temporary policy statement allowing the warm-pool tag and canary subnet (expires in 60m).

ben_infra: How do we identify warm-pool IPs reliably? we have mixed warmers across AZs.

carla_sre: Use the warmpool-label and the warmpool-iprange tag on infra side. I can run a query and produce an allowlist.

alex_ml: Also change IAM session duration for the provisioning role from 1h -> 3h during the cutover to reduce refresh churn. That helped in previous rollouts.

danielle_sec: Good call. I'll push the session-duration patch to org-policy + add the temporary policy. ops-bot will track the change.

ops-bot: [automated] policy-change-request submitted by danielle_sec at 2026-02-03T15:10:12Z — request id pc-177700A.

ben_infra: Runbook note (quick):
- generate warmpool allowlist: `./scripts/list-warmpool-ips --tag warmpool-iprange`
- apply temp KMS policy (expires 60m): `aws iam put-policy --policy-document file://tmp-kms-allow.json --policy-name tmp-warmpool-allow`
- bump session duration: `aws iam update-role --role-name provisioning-role --max-session-duration 10800`
- monitor keystore logs: `kubectl -n infra logs -l app=keystore-proxy --since=10m`

carla_sre: I'll prepare the tmp-kms-allow.json and the rollback snippet.

danielle_sec: Plan: 15:50 UTC prep, 16:00 UTC apply for eu-west1 canary, observe 20m, if green -> 16:30 start staggered region roll. If we hit >3 join failures in 20m we rollback.

alex_ml: Add a temporary alert rule for join-fail spikes: `alert:NodeJoinErrors > 3 for 10m` and hook to #eng-oncall.

ops-bot: [automated] alert-rule created: NodeJoinErrors-canary by danielle_sec.

ben_infra: One more cost/compliance note — the temporary allowlist increases audit surface. we should log the policy-change event to S3 and mark it in the internal compliance tracker.

danielle_sec: Yep will attach the policy-change ticket to compliance-log-2026-02 and add TTL tag on policy.

carla_sre: I'm standing by for the allowlist. will shadow the canary nodes during join.

danielle_sec: Thanks team. proceeding with plan unless objections in next 10m. :thumbsup:

ben_infra: :thumbsup:

alex_ml: :thumbsup:

ops-bot: [automated] canary-start scheduled at 2026-02-03T16:00:00Z (thread 1777001234).
